$description: Generated by `npm run tokens:build` from design/tokens.json. Figma mirrors the tokens and never owns them.

variables.name: surface/page
variables.description: The page behind everything.

variables.name: surface/card
variables.description: Cards and panels on the page.

variables.name: surface/raised
variables.description: Something lifted inside a card: a selected row, a nested panel.

variables.name: surface/overlay
variables.description: Popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts.

variables.name: surface/sunken
variables.description: Inset wells: a code area, a drop zone.

variables.name: surface/muted
variables.description: A neutral fill: chips, neutral badges, a quiet button.

variables.name: surface/hover
variables.description: The hover of a row or a quiet control, on any surface. Light: black at 5 percent. Dark: white at 7 percent.

variables.name: surface/scrim
variables.description: Behind a dialog or a sheet. Light: black at 40 percent. Dark: black at 55 percent.

variables.name: surface/chrome
variables.description: The chat chrome when it is opaque (its glass is glass.fill).

variables.name: surface/inverse
variables.description: Tooltips.

variables.name: text/tertiary
variables.description: Meta text, timestamps, placeholders. Still AA on every surface.

variables.name: text/inverse
variables.description: Text on surface.inverse.

variables.name: text/link-hover
variables.description: A link under the pointer.

variables.name: text/on-solid
variables.description: Text and icons on a solid or fill colour (status.*.fill, accent.agent.fill, a solid badge).

variables.name: border/subtle
variables.description: Dark: white at 6 percent.

variables.name: border/default
variables.description: Dark: white at 10 percent.

variables.name: border/strong
variables.description: Input boundaries at 3:1. Dark: white at 36 percent.

variables.name: action/fg
variables.description: Text and icons on an action fill.

variables.name: action/subtle
variables.description: A selected or brand-tinted surface.

variables.name: brand/mark
variables.description: The mark: the mid blue on light surfaces, white on dark ones, never navy. Never beside a primary button on a white row.

variables.name: status/danger/fill
variables.description: The danger button's fill, under text-on-solid.

variables.name: accent/agent/fill
variables.description: A purple fill under text-on-solid (a task row, a selected agent chip).

variables.name: glass/fill
variables.description: Light: white at 72 percent. Dark: navy.850 at 78 percent.

variables.name: glass/hover
variables.description: Light: white at 90 percent. Dark: navy.750 at 88 percent.

variables.name: glass/border
variables.description: Light: warm.300 at 60 percent. Dark: white at 10 percent.

variables.name: focus/ring
variables.description: The focus ring, 3:1 on every surface.

variables.name: code/border
variables.description: The slab's edge, white at 20 percent: the slab is two steps under the ink page, so without it a block has no edge in dark. Nearly invisible on a light page.

variables.name: scrollbar/thumb
variables.description: Dark: white at 18 percent.

variables.name: scrollbar/thumb-hover
variables.description: Dark: white at 28 percent.

variables.name: control/track
variables.description: An off switch's track: 3:1 on the surfaces. Dark: white at 36 percent.
